conviction_note: Both direct read-throughs that reported after Ichor last spoke (Lam's record Sep quarter and higher Dec guide, UCTT's beat above the top of its range and +9% Q4 guide) point to a Q3 at or above the $330m midpoint and a Q4 guide at or above the ~$360m implied by management's 'H2 at least 25% above H1' commitment. The stock is -39.5% in 20 days, mostly in a sector-wide sell-off (SOX's 8-day losing streak, Lam -11.8% on 2026-10-22 on its supply-constraint comment), and bullish sentiment is at 10.5%. Against that: this name sold an in-line/slightly-short quarter -11% last time, Q3 lands inside a guided range consensus already sits on, and Lam named 'certain components' as a constraint, the same category (flow control) that cost Ichor $5.2m of Q2 revenue. impact_sum +3.5 is the sum of the findings sized one by one. The scaled number is (2*0.56-1)*16 = +1.92, smaller because p_up carries the sign uncertainty and abs_move carries the scale. The two measurements agree in sign.

findings.finding: Ichor's largest customer, Lam Research, reported on 2026-10-21, after Ichor last spoke. Its September quarter was a record $8.22bn against its own ~$8.1bn outlook. It guided the December quarter to $8.6bn +/- $0.4bn (+5% q/q), said calendar-2026 systems revenue grows more than 40%, and gave a preliminary 2027 WFE forecast above $200bn (2026: mid-$150bn). Offsets in the same call: China falls 'significantly' from 35% of revenue in the December quarter, and the December guide 'would have been a little bit higher' without supply-chain constraints, with shipments slipping into March.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Ichor's moves track guidance and the WFE outlook. 2026-02-09: +32.7% on a strengthening-demand print. 2026-08-03: -11.2% when a Q2 revenue miss came with a raised H2 outlook. Lam itself fell about 11.8% on 2026-10-22 on the supply/China comments, and ICHR gapped down 7.5% the same day (swingtradebot gap table).
findings.why_not_priced: The market read Lam's call for its negatives (ICHR -7.5% gap, Lam -11.8%). Ichor ships subsystems about a quarter ahead of Lam's revenue, so Lam's higher December guide, March-quarter catch-up and >$200bn 2027 WFE frame are a forward demand signal for Ichor's Q4 guide that Ichor has not yet confirmed. If it were priced, ICHR would have held up with Lam's fundamentals instead of falling about 40% in 20 days.
findings.independence: Lam's own 8-K exhibit for the September quarter, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000707549/000070754926000052/lrcx_exhibitx991xq1x2027.htm (same company, a second document). Independent: UCTT's print (next finding).

findings.finding: Ultra Clean (UCTT) is Ichor's closest peer, a gas/fluid subsystem supplier to the same two customers (Lam and AMAT). It reported on 2026-10-27, after Ichor last spoke. Q3 revenue was a record $759m, up 18% q/q, above the top of its own $700-750m guide. It guided Q4 to $800-860m (midpoint +9% q/q) and non-GAAP EPS of $1.11-1.35, and cited 'accelerating customer demand'. Ichor's Q3 bar is only its guide midpoint ($330m, +12% q/q), and its Q4 bar is about +10% q/q.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: UCTT rose about 10% on its own print. ICHR gapped up only 2.8% on 2026-10-27, then fell about 10.5%, 9.1% and 8.3% on 2026-10-28 to 10-30 (swingtradebot), so it did not keep the read-through. Ichor sold off on its last print, which was slightly short on revenue with a raised outlook.
findings.why_not_priced: ICHR closed at $38.06 on 2026-10-26 and $38.30 on 2026-11-02, so it is flat-to-down across the peer's beat-and-raise. If the read-through were priced, ICHR would have re-rated with UCTT. The divergence may be Ichor-specific skepticism about flow-control supply and margins, which this finding does not resolve.
findings.independence: Independent of Lam's call (a different company and document). The UCTT Q3 guide of $700-750m is confirmed separately at https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/ultra-clean-nasdaquctt-updates-q3-2026-earnings-guidance-2026-08-03/

findings.finding: On Ichor's Q1 and Q2 2026 calls, management said its lithography customer was burning through inventory in Q3, called it a Q3 headwind and a Q4 tailwind, and expected a stronger Q4 and especially Q1 2027. ASML reported on 2026-10-14: record Q3 sales of €11.7bn, Q4 guided to €14.2-15.2bn, FY26 raised to €44-45bn, and planned 2027-2028 supply will not fully meet demand. That supports the litho pickup in Ichor's Q4 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no isolated past reaction to the litho line. Management flagged it as the Q3 headwind inside the existing $315-345m guide.
findings.why_not_priced: The Earnings Whispers preview lists 'fading litho demand' as a bear concern, so part of the market reads the litho line negatively. ASML's Q4 step-up has not been tied to Ichor's Q4 litho recovery in any preview found. If it were priced, the litho worry would not appear in the pre-print bear list.
findings.independence: Ichor's own litho statements: Q2 2026 call transcript, https://www.webull.com/news/15381684736648192, and Q1 call highlights, https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/ichor-q1-earnings-call-highlights-221752210.html. This is a proxy: ASML is not confirmed as the named litho customer in a document I read, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Component-supply risk to Ichor's Q3 shipments. On the Q2 call, CEO Barros said flow control is a supplier that 'definitely' keeps him up at night, and an isolated flow-control part shortage pushed about $5.2m of Q2 revenue into Q3, causing the Q2 revenue miss ($294.8m vs ~$300.2m consensus). On 2026-10-21 Lam said 'certain components' were in near-term shortage and capping its December quarter. A repeat at Ichor's September quarter-end would put Q3 revenue at or below the $330m midpoint.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-08-03: the supply-driven Q2 revenue miss plus the raised H2 outlook drew -11.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the Earnings Whispers preview names the flow-control shortage as a known worry. What is not resolved is whether Lam's October component constraint was in Ichor's supply chain. UCTT beating its range in the same quarter argues the subsystem tier shipped, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: Lam's 2026-10-21 call on component shortages, https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/transcript-lam-research-q1-earnings-call-highlights-2026-10-21/ (the same Lam document as finding 1, read for the opposite implication; the two are netted separately and it is noted here). Earnings Whispers names the same risk: https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/ICHR/21402

findings.finding: The ~40% 20-day drawdown is mostly sector and macro, not company-specific. The SOX fell eight straight sessions to 2026-10-16, its longest streak since 2008, and SOXX fell about 16% from its 10-06 close, on 5.1% 10-year yields, $100 oil and AI-capex doubts. Lam fell about 11.8% on 2026-10-22. Ichor filed no 8-K between 2026-08-03 and the print, and only 10b5-1 Form 4s. Bullish sentiment is 10.5% against 28.4% before the last report. The stock trades at $38.30, against $80.70 average for the 2.5m-share ATM and a $97 mean target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last print came into a stock near $80 and fell 11.2%. The 2026-02-09 print came off a depressed base and rose 32.7%. Five of the last eight reactions were down, with a median absolute move of 18.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: If ICHR's drawdown reflected Ichor-specific bad news, the EDGAR record (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001652535.json) or peers' prints would show it. Instead peers beat. A ~40% fall against UCTT's ~25% and Lam's double-digit declines suggests beta and de-risking, so the bar for a relief move is lower than the July bar. This is an inference, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Financing is done and funds a ramp, with no near-term dilution overhang. Ichor raised $195.4m net in Q2 via an ATM (2.5m shares at $80.70), leaving $256.5m cash against ~$120.6m debt at 2026-06-26. The money is buying inventory: a $38.4m Q2 inventory build, operating cash flow negative until 1H27 by management's own statement, and capacity for ~$2bn of revenue with expansion to $3bn starting in 2H26. At $38 there is no reason to tap the ATM again before the inventory converts.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The ATM disclosed with Q2 coincided with the -11.2% print; bears cited dilution and working capital (Simply Wall St, 2026-08-04).
findings.why_not_priced: Negative Q3 operating cash flow, likely from another inventory build, will read as a bear point on the print. That inventory is the ramp corroboration, and with $256m cash there is no funding gap. Mostly priced, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Q2 call commentary on inventory turns and capacity: https://www.webull.com/news/15381684736648192

findings.finding: Insiders made small, routine 10b5-1 sales into the drawdown: CFO Greg Swyt sold 689 shares at $65.01 on 2026-10-02 (47,143 retained) and 2,068 at $58.02 on 2026-09-08. Director Bruce Ragsdale filed a Form 4 for 2026-10-01. Form 144s were filed monthly from July to October. There were no open-market purchases at $38-65.
findings.why_not_priced: Trivial size under a pre-arranged plan. Filed because there was no insider buying after a ~60% fall from the high.

baseline_tension: The skew is balanced (+1.09) and gives no directional statement. The findings lean positive against a -39.5% 20-day run-up, a mean-reversion setup that is mostly sector beta, and this name's history of selling in-line quarters (-11.2% last time) pulls p_up toward 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 and 6, the Q3 lands inside the guided range consensus already sits on and this name sold its last quarter: the Lam read-through was cut 1.5 -> 1.0 and the UCTT read-through 2.0 -> 1.5, both reframed onto the Q4 guide; p_up 57 -> 56.

Lesson 5, a proxy is filed small: the ASML/litho finding was cut 1.0 -> 0.8 because ASML is not confirmed in a primary document as the named litho customer; the drawdown-is-sector finding was cut 1.5 -> 1.0 because it is an inference (the drawdown is explained, so it is not set to 0).
Lesson 4, financing: the ATM was read as funding an inventory/capacity ramp, kept small positive at 0.3.
Lesson 7: short interest checked before the negative supply finding (7.1% of shares out, 3.5 days to cover, not crowded), so the negative was left at -1.0.

Lesson 3: the Lam document is used for both a positive (demand) and a negative (component supply). These are different implications of one call, sized separately and flagged in independence; the China portion was merged into finding 1.
